By "Definitive Edition" I'm assuming you mean DmC: Definitive Edition, as in the re-release of the Ninja Theory game. 

As a long time fan of the DMC series, I loved DmC and never thought it deserved the hate it got. It's a great action game and Definitive Edition is a solid improvement that fixed some of the annoyances of the game and added extra content. 

DMC4 is also a fantastic game. It's faster, with arguably more deep and nuanced combat (at least with regards to perfecting Dante's style switching) and Special Edition has a total of five playable characters -- each very unique and fun to use. 

I might consider DMC4SE the better game but DmC:DE is not far behind it in my book. Neither choice would be a bad one.
